parsed.rationale: Both protocols live in the same file (`Shared/Playback/Sources/PlaybackCore/Protocols/RemoteCommandCenterProtocol.swift`) within the `Playback` package and share three identical members: `addTarget:`, `isEnabled:Bool`, and `removeTarget:`. `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` is a strict superset of `RemoteCommandProtocol`, adding only `preferredIntervals:[NSNumber]`. Making `SkipIntervalCommandProtocol` inherit from `RemoteCommandProtocol` eliminates the three duplicated declarations, enforces the subset relationship explicitly, and allows any code typed to `RemoteCommandProtocol` to accept skip-interval commands polymorphically without change.
